$description: Food vocabulary for recipe scaling (§5.4) — versioned DATA, not code, per the no-hardcoded-food-lists rule. fixedWhenScaled = seasonings/aromatics that do NOT scale with a portion (you don't double the salt). liquid/spoonable = unit-choice hints (ml vs g vs tsp/tbsp). A {word, notFollowedBy} entry encodes a negative lookahead — 'cream' but not 'cream cheese'. Each list builds ONE case-insensitive word-boundary regex at module load; transcribed verbatim from repo.ts's former inline regexes (order preserved). NOTE: shopping.ts keeps its own DIVERGENT liquid list (has wine/kefir, lacks water) — do not merge, it changes shopping-list units.
